title: 一部奥德赛：IMAX票房占比55%，谁在推动？
speaker: Daniel Munwaring

segments.en: You know, I think that number one word of mouth is driving everything, right?
segments.zh: 我认为口碑是第一驱动力。

segments.en: So it's no longer is it Hollywood or is it local? Audiences just want a really good movie.
segments.zh: 所以不再区分好莱坞还是本土，观众只想要真正的好电影。

segments.en: Looking at Spider-Man opening weekend, we open to a franchise historical high of over $19 million doing 16 plus percent of the box office.
segments.zh: 以《蜘蛛侠》开画周末为例，我们创下该系列历史新高，票房超过1900万美元，占大盘16%以上。

segments.en: And you know, Odyssey, again, another phenomena this summer, you know, we were doing 55% of the total box office on that title. I think we're up to 49 million overall.
segments.zh: 《奥德赛》也是今夏的现象级作品，我们贡献了该片总票房的55%，累计约4900万美元。

segments.en: So I think we're seeing a healthy mix of local language as well as Hollywood titles. But it's really about quality, audiences are demanding quality.
segments.zh: 我们看到了本土与好莱坞影片的健康组合，但核心还是品质，观众对品质的要求越来越高。
